versions.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Chatbot Prompt & Persona Builder.
- Provides four structured prompts to generate system prompts, persona/brand voice, guardrails, and FAQ training data for business AI chatbots.
- Supports workflows for SaaS, e-commerce, service industries, agencies, and more.
- Delivers ready-to-deploy content: system prompt templates, persona sheets, guardrails/rulesets, and JSONL Q&A datasets.
- Enables businesses to build advanced AI chatbots without prompt engineering expertise.
